interpretation_ko: 누군가 나쁜 짓을 저지르고 있다고 의심하게 될 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that you will be suspicious of wrong doing

cite.original: To think a spoon is lost, denotes that you will be suspicious of wrong doing.
cite.translation_ko: 숟가락을 잃어버렸다고 생각하는 꿈은, 누군가 나쁜 짓을 저지르고 있다고 의심하게 될 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 집안에서 한 못난 짓으로 비난받을 조짐
interpretation_en: is a sign that you will deserve censure for your contemptible meanness in your home

cite.original: To steal one, is a sign that you will deserve censure for your contemptible meanness in your home.
cite.translation_ko: 숟가락을 훔치는 꿈은, 집안에서 한 못난 짓으로 비난받을 조짐이다

cite.original: To dream of broken or soiled spoons, signifies loss and trouble.
cite.translation_ko: 부러지거나 더러운 숟가락을 보는 꿈은, 손실과 곤란을 겪을 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 순조로운 일과 즐거운 벗을 얻을 조짐
interpretation_en: is a sign of fortunate undertakings and cheerful companions

cite.original: To dream that spring is advancing, is a sign of fortunate undertakings and cheerful companions.
cite.translation_ko: 봄이 오고 있는 꿈은, 순조로운 일과 즐거운 벗을 얻을 조짐이다

interpretation_en: is a foreboding of disquiet and losses

cite.original: To see spring appearing unnaturally, is a foreboding of disquiet and losses.
cite.translation_ko: 봄이 제철과 다르게 나타나는 꿈은, 근심과 손실이 닥칠 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that you will engage in some unpleasant controversy

cite.original: To dream of wearing spurs, denotes that you will engage in some unpleasant controversy.
cite.translation_ko: 스스로 박차를 차는 꿈은, 달갑잖은 다툼에 얽힐 조짐이다

interpretation_en: foretells that enmity is working you trouble

cite.original: To see others with them on, foretells that enmity is working you trouble.
cite.translation_ko: 남이 박차를 찬 것을 보는 꿈은, 적개심이 곤란을 일으킬 조짐이다

cite.original: To dream that spies are harassing you, denotes dangerous quarrels and uneasiness.
cite.translation_ko: 첩자들에게 시달리는 꿈은, 위험한 다툼과 불안에 시달릴 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that you will make unfortunate ventures

cite.original: To dream that you are a spy, denotes that you will make unfortunate ventures.
cite.translation_ko: 스스로 첩자가 되는 꿈은, 무모한 시도를 하게 될 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that changes will soon occur to your disadvantage

cite.original: To dream that you are looking through a spy-glass, denotes that changes will soon occur to your disadvantage.
cite.translation_ko: 망원경으로 보는 꿈은, 머잖아 불리한 변화가 닥칠 조짐이다

interpretation_en: foretells unhappy dissensions and loss of friends

cite.original: To see a broken or imperfect one, foretells unhappy dissensions and loss of friends.
cite.translation_ko: 부서지거나 흠집 난 망원경을 보는 꿈은, 달갑잖은 불화와 벗을 잃을 조짐이다

cite.original: To dream of squalls, foretells disappointing business and unhappiness.
cite.translation_ko: 돌풍이 부는 꿈은, 사업이 실망스럽게 되고 불행할 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that you will be annoyed with unpleasant people

cite.original: To dream that you see some person with squinting eyes, denotes that you will be annoyed with unpleasant people.
cite.translation_ko: 곁눈질하는 사람을 보는 꿈은, 달갑잖은 이들 때문에 성가실 조짐이다

context: 남자가 애인이나 낯선 미인에게서 곁눈질을 받음
interpretation_ko: 여자를 쫓다 손해를 볼 위험에 처할 조짐
interpretation_en: foretells that he is threatened with loss by seeking the favors of women

cite.original: For a man to dream that his sweetheart, or some good-looking girl, squints her eyes at him, foretells that he is threatened with loss by seeking the favors of women.
cite.translation_ko: 남자가 애인이나 낯선 미인에게서 곁눈질을 받는 꿈은, 여자를 쫓다 손해를 볼 위험에 처할 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 고운 평판을 잃을 위험에 처할 조짐
interpretation_en: she will be in danger of losing her fair reputation

cite.original: For a young woman to have this dream about men, she will be in danger of losing her fair reputation.
cite.translation_ko: 여자가 남자에게서 곁눈질을 받는 꿈은, 고운 평판을 잃을 위험에 처할 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 즐거운 벗이 곧 찾아오고 사업도 나아질 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that pleasant friends will soon visit you; you will see advancement in your business also

cite.original: To dream of seeing squirrels, denotes that pleasant friends will soon visit you.  You will see advancement in your business also.
cite.translation_ko: 다람쥐들을 보는 꿈은, 즐거운 벗이 곧 찾아오고 사업도 나아질 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that you will be unfriendly and disliked

cite.original: To kill a squirrel, denotes that you will be unfriendly and disliked.
cite.translation_ko: 다람쥐를 죽이는 꿈은, 정을 잃고 미움받을 조짐이다

cite.original: To pet one, signifies family joy.
cite.translation_ko: 다람쥐를 예뻐하는 꿈은, 집안에 기쁜 일이 생길 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 벗 사이에 다툼과 불화가 생길 조짐
interpretation_en: foretells disagreements and unpleasantness among friends

cite.original: To see a dog chasing one, foretells disagreements and unpleasantness among friends.
cite.translation_ko: 개가 다람쥐를 쫓는 것을 보는 꿈은, 벗 사이에 다툼과 불화가 생길 조짐이다
